evidence: Modifies net_processing.cpp to drop transactions upfront at P2P deserialization if they have zero inputs/outputs or exceed the 4M weight budget.
rationale: Enforcing upfront deserialization bounds directly protects P2P message processing from allocating unbounded memory before validation runs. The PR alters P2P behavior so that empty or oversized transactions are dropped at the transport/deserialization stage rather than rejected after validation.
